en.Inizia dunque una nuova era, caratterizz: A new era therefore begins, characterized by the idea of Luigi Antonio Zito nephew, to transfer passion to his customers through creations close to their needs such as not wanting to give up an accessory that is sometimes elegant, sometimes informal, sometimes unique: in a globalized market, where much seems to conform to market rules, it is no longer enough to follow fashions, you have to propose them. In other words, you must have the ability to innovate and be original.
en.Una storia che abbiamo voluto concretizz: A story that we wanted to realize today in two moments: one to wear on the wrist with reliability and lots of character, the other to keep in the pocket or on the desk.

en.Il tempo fugge e l'orologio non ha il po: Time flees and the clock has no power to stop it, it only has the function of reminding us that the before no longer exists and that life must be lived in the precise second indicated on the dial.
en.L'orologio era per me, allo stesso tempo: The watch was for me, at the same time, a wonderful tool and a faithful companion. The first heartbeat, the first "tic" was a unique experience like the beginning of a new life.
en.Dopo aver assemblato e data la prima car: After having assembled and given the first charge to the complex set of wheels and balance wheel, the ear enters into a sort of "galactic melody", where each part depends on the other as in a "microscopic universe"! ETA calibres 2824, 7001 and 2671, Valjoux 7750, Tourbillon.
en.Cassa e movimento si accoppiano diventan: Case and movement are coupled to become a harmonious whole with shaft and crown. Each element works perfectly: the gears begin to rotate and the second hand begins its infinite rotations, in synchrony and with the complicity of the minute and hour hand.

en.Selvaggio, primitivo e misterioso, l'oud: Wild, primitive and mysterious, oud also known as Agarwood, is even mentioned in the Bible in the Song of Songs. Few perfumes in the world can boast such noble and remote origins.
en.L’oud, noto anche come Agarwood, è il pr: Oud, also known as Agarwood, is the perfume par excellence in the Middle East: the elites of the Gulf countries pay astronomical sums to purchase small ampoules of this oil, of which a few drops are sufficient to spread an intense fragrance.
en.E pensare che invece l’oud è originario: And to think that oud originates from south-east Asia. This resin is in fact one of the most curious productions of nature: it is an aromatic exudation that Aquilaria type trees produce to protect themselves from attacks by mould, fungi or insects that damage their bark.
